THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

This petition is filed challenging registration of Crime No.377/2018 for the offences punishable under Sections 120B, 420 and 34 of IPC by the petitioners, who were accused Nos.2 and 3.
2.
Learned High Court Government Pleader places on record the final 'B' report, in which, it is stated that no offence has been made out against the petitioners.
3. In view of the fact that the 'B' report has been filed against the petitioners, it is obvious that this petition has NC: 2024:KHC:20794 become unnecessary.
Accordingly, recording 'B' report that is filed, this petition is disposed off.
